objective: Add a rename-stable Semantic File Identity layer inside the existing Semantic OS: a new hand-authored record kind (kind=file_identity, dotted-slug id) mapping semantic_id -> semantic_name -> physical_path, plus a filename_semantic_status classification (ALIGNED/HISTORICAL/MISLEADING/COMPATIBILITY/SPLIT/UNKNOWN). Tier 1/2 curated in YAML (~50-60 load-bearing modules incl. confirmed-misleading src/engines/rr_engine.py, compatibility shim src/engines/gaussian_engine.py, historically-named src/config_layer/crt_engine_v2.py); Tier 3 machine-derived at seed time from a deterministic path-slug function over the remaining code universe. Joined onto OBJ: records in semantic_objects.py and onto the three existing business-functionality Excel workbooks (append-only new columns). No Python file renamed, no import modified, no runtime behavior, formula, threshold, or config changed. Layer is authority=advisory (grants no promotion/production authority per Sec 6.5).
affected_models: none — advisory metadata layer only, no model input/training/artifact touched

runtime_impact.note: governance.semantic_identity is imported only by governance.semantic_objects and governance.semantic_os (permanent invariant enforced by test_identity_layer_touches_no_runtime_module); the identity layer is never on the crt/engine_runner/backtest/live spine import path
